Every published image or slip that differs visibly from the one before is a version, numbered in release order; a printed errata mark that does not match that order is recorded as a PC transcription error (Bill, 12 November 2026). A slip on a Players Committee release sheet and the PC card image are separate publications, so each is its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: “a change is a change”).
* '''Original''' ([[Captain Moden Canady]]): PC card image of 7 August 2025<ref name="ht-mc-0">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/782182256b44863b5363404bf248c0502ee71360/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual25-Dark/large/captainmodencanady.gif captainmodencanady.gif], commit [https://api.github.com/repos/swccgpc/holotable/git/commits/782182256b44863b5363404bf248c0502ee71360 7821822] (7 August 2025).</ref>, no errata mark. The image uses the Decipher artwork with its “TM & © 1996 LUCASFILM LTD.” copyright line. Text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting a [First Order] starship, it is armor and immunity to attrition +1 (if Fulminatrix, it is armor +2 and immune to attrition < 6 instead). During battle, cancels Alternatives To Fighting, Hit And Run, and opponent's 'reacts.'”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 25 release sheet<ref name="sheet25-20250810">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (PDF, 10 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, August 2025”; file created 10 August 2025). The printed footer identifies the August 2025 edition; the PDF creation date is file metadata.</ref>, page 1, file created 10 August 2025: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting a [First Order] starship, it is armor and immunity to attrition +1 (if Fulminatrix, it is armor +2 and immune to attrition &lt; 6 instead). During battle, cancels Alternatives To Fighting, Hit And Run, and opponent's 'reacts.'” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Captain Moden Canady]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Captain Moden Canady]] (repository revision 7 August 2025) as a printable slip under the label “•Captain Moden Canady”, pixel for pixel the same except that the picture area is left blank (white), so the slip can be laid over the picture of the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Lieutenant Cabbel]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).

Text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting a [First Order] starship, it is armor and immunity to attrition +1 (if Fulminatrix, it is armor +2 and immune to attrition < 6 instead). During battle, cancels Alternatives To Fighting, Hit And Run, and opponent's 'reacts.'”
